# fhir-harness-typologies

The graph typologies fhir-harness owns, one folio-graph-typology/v1 node per file (bean dmx1). Owner, 2026-10-04: no central registry for subgraph types; a harness declares its own in a kinds/ graph. The registry loads these on first use, across every instance, and refuses a kind two files declare.

Part of [FHIR IG Harness](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `fhir-harness-typologies`, holding `typologies`.

| file | what it is | used by |
|---|---|---|
| [`fhir-artifact-index.json`](fhir-artifact-index.json) | FHIR artefact index |  |
| [`ig-annex.json`](ig-annex.json) | IG annexes |  |
| [`ig-artifact-jsonld.json`](ig-artifact-jsonld.json) | IG artefact JSON-LD |  |
| [`ig-ast.json`](ig-ast.json) | IG AST |  |
| [`ig-metadata-index.json`](ig-metadata-index.json) | IG metadata index |  |
| [`ig-pages.json`](ig-pages.json) | IG pages |  |
